info.headline: Notify NYC - Traffic Delays - Bruckner Expressway (BX)
info.description:
Notification issued 10-30-2026 at 06:25 AM.
Due to a vehicle fire, expect extensive northbound traffic delays on the Bruckner Expressway at Buhre Avenue in The Bronx. Consider alternate routes and allow for additional travel time.
